name: PROPHET 67
description: PROPHET 67: a 7-voice analogue-style poly after the Prophet-6. Two oscillators with sub and noise, poly mod, a resonant high-pass into a creamy 4-pole low-pass, two LFOs (LFO 1 to audio rate and noise), distortion, chorus, delay, five reverbs, an arp. The same engine as the PROPHET 67 VST3 and the FM-1 firmware.
author: swtdr34mz
